decisions.reason: Only mentioned on the website indicates lower public commitment, but sunk costs and lack of clear persistent failure make management reluctant to drop.
Dedicated website page in both years signals strong public commitment and investment, so escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping.
Limited website visibility implies less commitment, yet prior investment and absence of non-temporary negative results keep drop probability moderate.
Like other mentioned-only products, lower public visibility is offset by sunk costs and the desire to justify the original launch.
Downgraded from own page to mention may indicate reduced priority, but earlier investment and public exposure still discourage dropping.
Similar to E, reduced visibility tempers commitment, but escalation tendencies and existing sunk costs keep drop probability low.
